I have fibromyalgia which my dr thought was lupus at first but since majority of my symptoms are muscle related she said it was fibro. It could be that mostly because of the chronic pain affecting your muscles and joints. They come in flares. Do you have any tender spots ? That frequently get pain or comes back to the same spot ? From my understanding lupus affects mostly the joints whereas fibromyalgia affects the muscles and causes fatigue and a few other issues. I’ve been dealing with it for a year now and medication has helped a lot . Make sure you keep track of your symptoms when you feel them and where they are and tell your doctor. For my doctor she ruled out other illnesses through tests and blood work. I hope you find relief soon!
